title: Memorization and Generalization in Generative Models: A Perspective From Energy-based Modeling and Associative Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.26797v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative models now write working code, produce realistic images, and hold long conversations, yet the mechanisms behind their intelligence still evade our understanding. This thesis explores that puzzle through Associative Memory (AM), in which patterns are stored as energy minima and retrieved through attractor dynamics. Beyond their capacity, AMs form new minima known as spurious states, long regarded as a failure of memory. We argue that this failure is where creativity begins, and that memorization and generalization can coexist as outcomes of one retrieval process. First, we show that diffusion models behave as AMs. With little data, a diffusion model forms a distinct basin of attraction around each training sample. As the data grows, these basins shrink, and spurious states emerge as attractors that blend stored samples yet match none of them. They are the first signs of generative capability. translated_title: 生成模型中的记忆与泛化：基于能量建模与联想记忆的视角
translated_abstract: 生成模型如今已能编写可运行的代码、生成逼真的图像并进行长对话，但其智能背后的机制仍未被我们理解。本论文通过联想记忆（Associative Memory, AM）来探索这一谜题：在联想记忆中，模式以能量极小值的形式被存储，并通过吸引子动力学进行检索。除了存储容量之外，AM 还会形成一类被称为“伪状态”的新极小值，这长期以来被视为记忆的失败。我们提出，这种“失败”正是创造力的起点，记忆与泛化可以作为同一检索过程的两种结果而共存。首先，我们证明扩散模型表现为一种联想记忆。当数据很少时，扩散模型会在每个训练样本周围形成各自独立的吸引盆；随着数据量增长，这些吸引盆逐渐缩小，而伪状态作为融合了已存储样本却不匹配任何单个样本的吸引子开始涌现——它们正是生成能力的最初征兆。我们通过……刻画了这一转变（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文从能量建模与联想记忆的视角提出：扩散模型本质上是一种联想记忆，随着数据增长而涌现的“伪状态”吸引子正是生成能力的开端，因此记忆与泛化可以在同一检索过程中共存。
en_tdlr: From the perspective of energy-based modeling and associative memory, this thesis shows that diffusion models behave as associative memories whose emerging spurious attractor states, as data grows, are the first signs of generative capability—arguing that memorization and generalization coexist within a single retrieval process.
